mobbin:9e0d5df7-8fea-4a21-9032-7a84de9d1.summary: From an open Doc, the user opens the Templates sidebar, chooses Save as Template, fills name/description/tags and Share-with radios, saves, and lands on a success toast with Open in Template Center.
steps: Tag applied; Share with All members
steal: Save modal: Share with radios — All members / Only me / Select people / Admins only / Everyone (incl. guests) plus Public sharing off by default.
Footer shortcut: Update an existing Template vs Save as new in the same modal.
Required name: Save Template disabled until named; red border on empty field.
Success toast names the template and links Open in Template Center.
avoid: Public sharing toggle that creates an external link — too open for clinical scenario IP.
mobbin:9e0d5df7-8fea-4a21-9032-7a84de9d1.fit: Extends SCE authoring with save-as-template + per-template access (private / people / org) for simpler sharing than today's opaque SCE permissions.

mobbin:456a85db-8ced-4de2-b541-c685bca7e.summary: On a task detail, the user creates a checklist, adds items with per-item assignees, sees progress 0/N and a Use Template option, alongside assigned comments and attachments.
steps: Empty Checklists section + New checklist item
First item; Add checklist / Use Template
steal: Per-item assignee icon on checklist rows (role split: tech vs faculty).
Section header progress: Checklists 0/N plus 'N for me' filter badge.
Use Template beside Add checklist — reuse item sets across tasks.
Inline + New checklist item without leaving the parent record.
avoid: No scoring, required flags, or rubric weights — too thin for learner evaluation checklists.
mobbin:456a85db-8ced-4de2-b541-c685bca7e.fit: Extends the cut-down Case Manager checklist with assignees + reuse templates; still needs scoring/respondent timing for Essentials eval, and does not cover QR-no-login.

mobbin:e17ac016-5f41-4926-bdbc-525e0a847.summary: From a space Overview, the user opens Automations, builds a When→Then rule (task created → change assignees + task type), creates it, and manages it Active with a toggle on the Manage tab.
steps: Builder: When task created → Set Custom Field
steal: When→Then visual blocks with natural-language summary sentence under the canvas.
Inline warning: action skipped if assignee lacks access.
Dynamic roles in assignee picker (Task creator / Triggered by / Watchers).
Manage tab: Active/Inactive counts + per-rule on/off toggle after create.
avoid: Full Browse libraries of integrations and multi-category rule catalogs — heavier than per-scenario defaults (auto-record, prep email, announcements).
mobbin:e17ac016-5f41-4926-bdbc-525e0a847.fit: Extends today's scheduling-template auto-record/email/announcements into an explicit When→Then defaults panel per scenario; keep presets narrow, not a general automation product.
